ledger: Tablecloth | center has a light green circular pattern | center is solid red | pattern morphs and disappears during camera pullback
Three red cups | arranged in a triangle (one front, two back) | arranged in a straight horizontal line | layout morphs without interaction during camera pan
Coin on back-right cup | resting horizontally over the cup's opening | absent | disappears during camera movement

findings.description: The center of the tablecloth changes from a light green circular pattern to a solid red surface as the camera pulls back.
The spatial arrangement of the three cups morphs from a triangular formation into a straight horizontal line as the viewpoint changes, without any physical manipulation.
The coin resting on top of the back-right cup vanishes entirely as the camera pans, without being moved or falling.
